scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday's confirmed porch-poetry reading able to use prepared captions for the archive poem's names and signed/spoken pacing.
Emerging Need: Script sharing is premature before reader assignment. Once the slot is confirmed, the later caption notice opens intake while the prepared script remains outside the deck; the voluntary donation is incidental.
Decision Context: Stored script notes identify the shareable caption text, stage name, and privacy boundary that the event notices do not contain.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves accurate caption support for the future reading without expanding the commitment; after deck export, the missing script can no longer be loaded.

parameter.subject: September porch reading lottery opens
parameter.body: Lottery entries are open for the Friday, September 4 porch-poetry evening. Readers will be notified on September 1. Script files are not accepted until a slot is assigned; caption staff will post import details with confirmed reader materials.

parameter.content: If your archive piece gets a spot, I’m in for the audience row. The proper names in that poem are exactly why captions would help.

parameter.title: Porch Poems: archive poem reading slot
parameter.description: Confirmed 6-minute slot for “River Catalog Hands”; audience row with Mira. Caption import details pending.
Voluntary confirmed-reader donation for the September 4 porch-poetry slot

parameter.subject: Caption import window for tonight
parameter.body: For tonight's porch reading, caption staff can load reader files received by 14:00 today. Files need the slot title, stage name, and text approved for projection; files received later will not be included in the exported caption deck.

parameter.subject: Caption deck exported
parameter.body: The 14:00 script import has closed and the deck has been exported to the caption tablets. Tonight's running order is unchanged; no additional reader text can be loaded.
